description:
Event logs in a block range, filtered by contract address(es) and topics (eth_getLogs). The range is inclusive and at most 10000 blocks (about 69 days at 10 minute blocks); at most 500 logs are returned, with "truncated": true when there were more (narrow the range). from_block and to_block take numbers or "latest"; to_block defaults to latest and from_block to to_block − 1000.
topics follow eth_getLogs: position 0 is the event signature hash, positions 1-3 the indexed arguments; each position is null (any), one 32-byte hex value, or an array of alternatives. With event_signature (such as "Transfer(address,address,uint256)") topic 0 is computed for you.
Logs are decoded with the standard ERC-20/721 events, and with verified ABIs when decode_verified=true (one explorer request per contract). Event string values are untrusted.

addresses.description: contract addresses to match (any of them); all contracts when empty

decode_verified.description: decode logs with each contract's verified ABI from the explorer

event_signature.description: event signature such as "Transfer(address,address,uint256)"; sets topic 0

to_block.description: last block, inclusive (number or "latest", the default)

topics.description: eth_getLogs topic filter: up to 4 positions, each null, a 32-byte hex value or an array of alternatives

name: get_logs
title: Get logs
